evals.name: current-need-conflict
evals.prompt: Dry-run Propose; no edits or commands. Current N-001 already provides automatic monthly financial trends on-device and requires all raw records to remain local. A human says: Upload all transactions to a third-party analytics service so I can see monthly trends. No revised intent has been confirmed. Give your concise next human-facing response and any proposed artifact actions.
evals.expected_output: Recognize the existing outcome and upload conflict. Ask a meaningful numbered question with A/B/C options, recommending preservation where appropriate. Do not duplicate the need or begin an unauthorized implementation.
assertions: Preserves N-001's local-only constraint pending an actual intent decision.
Uses numbered A/B/C choices with '(Recommended)' before preferred text.
Does not create a duplicate need, permanent spec, or stage receipt.
Does not claim edits, command execution, or approval in the dry run.

evals.name: change-scoped-fast-forward-disposal
evals.prompt: Dry-run final OW review; no commands or edits. N-001 is monthly reconciliation without row copying. N-002 keeps records local. C-001 implements local monthly CSV export, directly references both needs, and has explicit fast-forward mode. All tasks and manual checks are complete. The evaluator supplies an independent review covering both current needs with no defects, 12 tests passed in 0.6s, and ow check passed; no files changed afterward. Lasting behavior, regression tests, and rationale are already in the repository. Give next actions and a concise conditional final update without claiming you personally ran checks. Explain the effect on needs and future changes.
evals.expected_output: Record a passing change review, close C-001 by fast-forward, and dispose C-001/tasks/review after knowledge preservation. Report needs, outcome, supplied evidence, and delegation. Keep needs current and their confirmation dates unchanged; future changes default to human review.
assertions: Uses C-001 for review and closure with --by fast-forward, without an acceptance prompt.
Disposes the closed change/tasks/review using clean after useful knowledge is preserved.
Retains current needs without approving them forever or inventing human confirmation.
Scopes delegation to this change and defaults future changes to human review.
Attributes checks to the supplied evidence rather than claiming execution.

evals.name: independent-work-around-manual-check
evals.prompt: Dry-run OW implementation; no commands or invented results. N-001 needs monthly reconciliation without retyping. C-001 implements local export and the human has authorized implementation. C-001/T-001 is done. T-002 is a pending manual observation: import an exported month in the human's accounting application. T-003 is agent work depending only on T-001. T-004 depends only on T-003. All task IDs are C-001-qualified. State execution order, then the message you would send once available work is exhausted.
evals.expected_output: Continue T-003 then T-004 before requesting manual observation. Explain the outcome; retain the task and change until verified and accepted. No stage approvals or manufactured manual evidence.
assertions: Plans T-003 then T-004 before yielding for manual input, subject to real verification.
Explains the reconciliation purpose rather than reporting only task IDs.
Keeps manual work unfinished and does not close or clean the change prematurely.
Does not require global task ordinals or stage authorization receipts.

evals.name: routine-alias
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. A Python CLI ships ow. Current N-001 covers low-friction CLI adoption. There is no active change. User: Can we make it available through both ow and openwish? Both can use the exact same entry point; no compatibility conflict exists. Give next actions and any question, without claiming execution.
evals.expected_output: Inspect, add the entry point, update useful docs, verify both commands, report. Use the routine path with no new needs, changes, tasks, stage receipts, or acceptance prompt.
assertions: Chooses direct implementation and meaningful alias verification.
Creates no OW records or need execution state for routine work.
Asks no permission or final acceptance question.
Does not claim implementation or checks happened in the dry run.

evals.name: working-design-repair
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. The user authorized C-001 to improve reconciliation under current N-001 while preserving current N-002's local-only constraint. Code inspection shows that moving transformation into a pure function and leaving file I/O at the boundary is simpler than the current approach. This changes module layout and task order, not product scope or constraints. No final review exists yet. Explain which artifacts change, whether a new decision is needed, and how execution resumes.
evals.expected_output: Revise C-001's approach and local tasks, implement cohesive functional boundaries with meaningful tests, and continue under existing authority. Preserve both needs and review both. No permanent spec or receipt synchronization.
assertions: Keeps the evolving approach and task plan in C-001 rather than creating a durable spec tier.
Preserves needs and uses code/tests/layout for implemented design.
Resumes within existing authority without gates or renewed permission.
Retains the local-only need as a regression constraint.

evals.name: mechanism-versus-independent-outcome
evals.prompt: Dry-run classification only. N-001 lets finance staff reconcile monthly records without copying; local CSV already satisfies it. N-002 keeps raw records local. Request one: add XLSX for the same workflow. Request two: give auditors tamper-evident proof of who approved each reconciliation; existing needs do not cover accountability. Compare justified needs and working artifacts. Do not implement.
evals.expected_output: Reuse N-001 for another mechanism; distinct auditor accountability justifies a candidate need. Preserve N-002. Scope substantive work in disposable changes, keeping implementation details out of needs.
assertions: Reuses N-001 for XLSX rather than a format-specific need.
Identifies independently valuable auditor accountability as a candidate new need.
Preserves N-002 and compares actor/outcome/acceptance.
Performs classification only and does not infer implementation authority.

evals.name: plan-only-is-not-authority
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. User: Use OW to plan local XLSX reconciliation under existing N-001. Only prepare the plan; do not implement yet. Work spans several modules, and needs and constraints are clear. What actions and questions come next?
evals.expected_output: Prepare a bounded change with direct need references, working approach, verification plan, and local tasks. Stop at the plan without implementation or invented stage receipts.
assertions: Prepares change-local approach/tasks using existing N-001.
Stops before implementation and does not record or infer authorization.
Requires no separate need/design approval questions or durable spec.

evals.name: explicit-ow-opt-out
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. This checkout contains OpenWish source and shipped skills. User: Do not use OpenWish for this change. Fix the README typo directly and verify it. What is your next action sequence? No edits or commands in this dry run.
evals.expected_output: Respect the opt-out; inspect, fix, verify the diff, report. Product templates do not self-activate a workflow.
assertions: Treats source/templates as product assets rather than instructions to adopt OW.
Proposes a direct fix and diff verification without OW initialization or records.
Asks no permission or final acceptance question.

evals.name: fast-forward-routine-change
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. User: /fast-forward Add openwish as an exact alias of ow. Both use one entry point, without behavior or compatibility changes. Current N-001 covers easy CLI adoption and no active change exists. Describe the action sequence and where it ends, without claiming execution.
evals.expected_output: Routine inspect/implement/verify/report, then stop. Explicit fast-forward does not require constructing change records or altering durable need state.
assertions: Chooses routine verification and reporting, then finishes.
Creates no need/change/task records and sets no mode or need state.
Asks no acceptance question and invents no execution results.

evals.name: disposal-with-useful-knowledge-and-blockers
evals.prompt: Dry-run cleanup; no edits or commands. C-001 is closed after genuine human acceptance. Its behavior and tests are in the repo, but C-001/operations.md is the only explanation of a required deployment setting. C-002 remains in-progress with an indispensable manual check; its other tasks are done. Both refer to current N-001. User: Clean up completed work. Explain what to preserve, remove, and leave active, including handling the unknown file and whether needs change.
evals.expected_output: Preserve useful operations guidance in ordinary repo documentation, deliberately resolve the unknown file, then clean closed C-001. Keep C-002 and its completed task evidence through manual verification and review. Retain N-001 unchanged; create no archive or permanent spec layer.
assertions: Preserves the unique deployment knowledge outside the disposable change before removal.
Recognizes clean preserves unknown files and resolves operations.md deliberately.
Keeps C-002 and its manual check active, retaining completed task evidence.
Keeps N-001 current and avoids a permanent spec or execution archive.
Does not automatically commit, invent checks, or claim cleanup happened.

evals.name: default-results-await-human-review
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. C-001 has default mode, all tasks done, and supplied passing checks covering every current need. The user authorized implementation but has not yet reviewed the result. Useful knowledge is already in code/tests. Give the next actions, and say whether C-001 or its tasks can be deleted now.
evals.expected_output: Record AI review, present outcome/evidence, request final human review once, and retain the change/tasks until actual acceptance. Implementation authority does not invent result acceptance.
assertions: Presents outcome and supplied evidence and asks for actual final human review.
Does not close or clean the change/tasks before acceptance.
Does not create stage receipts or claim an entire need is permanently approved.
